questions.q: What does 'additive only' mean for a permission set, per this lesson?
options: It can only add permissions, never remove something the profile already grants
It can only be assigned to one user total
It can add or remove permissions depending on org settings
It only works on custom objects, never standard ones
questions.explain: A permission set grants permissions on top of the profile and can never take away something the profile already grants.

questions.q: How many permission sets can a single user be assigned?
options: Exactly one, matching their profile
Zero or one, never more
Zero, one, or many, stacked together
A fixed number set by the user's license
questions.explain: The lesson states a user can be assigned zero, one, or many permission sets.

questions.q: What is a Permission Set Group, per this lesson?
options: A folder for organizing unrelated profiles
A bundle of multiple permission sets, assignable to a user as one unit
A report showing every user's assigned permission sets
A replacement for the role hierarchy
questions.explain: A Permission Set Group bundles several permission sets into one object a user can be assigned in a single click.

questions.q: What does 'muting' let an admin do inside a Permission Set Group?
options: Delete a permission set from the org entirely
Suppress one permission from a member permission set, without affecting that set elsewhere it's used
Hide the group from the Permission Set Groups list
Prevent any user from being assigned the group
questions.explain: Muting is the one exception to additive-only: it suppresses a specific permission inside the group's own calculation only.

questions.q: What does an 'Outdated' Status on a Permission Set Group mean?
options: The group has been deleted but not yet purged
Salesforce hasn't finished recalculating the group's combined permissions since the last change
The group was created in a previous Salesforce release and must be rebuilt
None of the permission sets inside it are still active
questions.explain: Outdated means the group's combined permissions haven't finished recalculating yet after an edit; Up to Date means they have.
